contracts.name: fieldAt
contracts.signature: function fieldAt(text: string, separator: string, index: number, fallback: string): string

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Separator is nonempty. Index is an integer from -2 through 70.
